name: Space Cargo Hauler
source:
You're a steely-eyed space captain, tasked with hauling consumer goods from one end of the galaxy to the other. Everything on your ship is fully automated – so you're not even sure why you're here.

One day, in a fit of ennui, you stop watching the autopilot and decide to do a little exploring...

This will not end well.

[From [url=https://calamitous.itch.io/space-cargo-hauler]Itch.io[/url]]
